Tool-specific customizations for implementing the MBOE profile in Cameo Concept Modeler

The tool-specific customizations in this diagram support the domain specific language (DSL) implementation of the stereotypes declared in this model using the MVF custom diagram type in the main MBOE model. Note that not all stereotypes require customizations.

For more detail on what the various customizations mean and entail, see the documentation at docs.nomagic.com/display/MD190SP4/Creating+Customization+Data
